description: Scan text for likely dash misuse: a hyphen surrounded by spaces where an em dash is probably intended ("word - word"), a double hyphen ("--") left unconverted, and inconsistent spacing around em dashes across the same document (mixing "word — word" and "word—word"). Pure regex heuristic, not a grammar parser.

text.description: The text to scan for dash usage issues

name: check_dash_usage
